faq.title: Frequently asked questions.
faq.lead: What everyone asks before generating their first challenge.
faq.q1: Do I need to pay to start?
faq.a1: No. When you confirm your email and phone you get 2 credits, enough to generate 2 complete challenges. After that, 10 credits cost R$ 10.00.
faq.q2: Why do you ask for my phone?
faq.a2: To ensure one account per person and keep the credits free. The verification is done through Telegram, with no SMS and no cost, and the number isn't used for anything else.
faq.q3: What if I don't like the challenge?
faq.a3: Each challenge can be regenerated once, for free. Both versions stay saved so you can choose.
faq.q4: Can I put it in my portfolio?
faq.a4: You can and should. Export the challenge to markdown for your repository's README and, if you want, make it public with a shareable link.
faq.a5: Yes. Each generation starts from a real industry scenario and avoids repeating the topics you've already received.
